questions.question: Why did Maki leave the Zenin family?
questions.subject: Maki Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: She wanted to become stronger despite her inability to see cursed spirits, so she left her family in order to hone her skills

questions.question: How did the Zenin clan higher-ups respond to Maki declaring she would become clan head?
questions.subject: Maki Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: they sought to stifle her efforts at every stage, going as far as to prevent her promotion from a grade 4 jujutsu sorcerer despite her obvious talent

questions.question: What happened to Maki when Geto attacked the first-years right before the Night Parade?
questions.subject: Maki Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: Geto mortally wounds Maki, and then injures Panda and Toge as well.

questions.question: How did Maki react to learning that Yuji had died?
questions.subject: Maki Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: This shocks Maki, causing her to lash out at Panda and Toge for not telling her earlier.

questions.question: Why did Nobara come to admire Maki?
questions.subject: Maki Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: Nobara then grows to admire Maki for remaining strong even though the latter's family had disowned her.

questions.question: How did Maki win her fight with Mai at the Kyoto Goodwill Event?
questions.subject: Maki Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: Maki manages to catch the bullet with her bare hand and disarm Mai.

questions.question: Who rescued Maki and Megumi while they were fighting Hanami?
questions.subject: Maki Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: Suddenly Aoi and Yuji show up and rescue the two.

questions.question: Who nominated Maki for a promotion to grade 1 sorcerer?
questions.subject: Maki Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: Maki is nominated by Mei Mei and Aoi Todo for a promotion to a grade 1 sorcerer.

questions.question: How did Maki get Playful Cloud during Dagon's Domain Expansion?
questions.subject: Maki Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: Suddenly Megumi breaks into the territory and gives Maki the Playful Cloud cursed tool.

questions.question: What did Jogo do to Maki at Shibuya?
questions.subject: Maki Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: Jogo moves towards Maki and immolates her from the chest up with a flick of the wrist, causing her to fall unconscious.

questions.question: According to Tengen, why did Kenjaku switch from eradicating Six Eyes bearers to sealing them?
questions.subject: Maki Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: After having lost twice to a sorcerer with the Six Eyes in the past, Kenjaku had switched to sealing instead of eradicating the Six Eyes and thus began searching for the Prison Realm because two bearers of the Six Eyes cannot appear at the same time.

questions.question: How did Maki kill her father Ogi Zenin in the training room?
questions.subject: Maki Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: As he challenges her to fight, she quickly cuts his head horizontally in two, killing him.

questions.question: How did Maki attack Sukuna during the fight against Gojo?
questions.subject: Maki Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: Maki then entered the domain and stabbed Sukuna through the chest while his guard was down using the Split Soul Katana.

questions.question: How did Maki and Miwa get out of the fight with Sukuna?
questions.subject: Maki Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: Maki and Miwa were then transferred to safety by Aoi Todo's Boogie Woogie.

questions.question: What happened to Maki after the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Maki Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: Maki and Yuta got married and started a family, having a son named Iori, in 2031.

questions.question: What did Maki say to Tsurugi about Mai's death?
questions.subject: Maki Zenin/Synopsis

answer.item: Maki cried as she lamented that while her death made her stronger, she constantly thought to herself if it was truly necessary, pondering whether different choices could have ensured Mai would still be alive today.
Maki would pass away at some point in 2079, much to the sadness of her grandchildren and her husband, the latter who fell into depression and grew weaker, dying the next year.
